sources.title: Planning applications and decisions
sources.verified_claim: PlanApps covers applications referred to the Mayor and decisions since 2012; search capability does not establish a candidate has a referable application.

sources.title: Referral process for LPAs
sources.verified_claim: Referable applications of potential strategic importance follow Stage 1 and Stage 2 processes; current guidance also describes the Category 3J notification route effective from 11 May 2026.

sources.title: What powers does the Mayor have for planning applications?
sources.verified_claim: GLA states referability criteria include strategic thresholds and describes Stage 1 comments, Stage 2 decision and possible Mayoral takeover; no candidate scheme is assumed to meet them.

sources.title: Commenting on a planning application
sources.verified_claim: The page distinguishes local planning authority responsibility at Stages 1/2 from Mayor responsibility at Stage 3; procedural stage is not permission status.

sources.title: Public Hearings, Mayoral call-ins, Directions to Refuse and Appeals
sources.verified_claim: Mayoral takeover requires the applicable strategic tests and a public hearing; call-in powers do not imply any sample parcel is subject to a live case.

sources.title: PlanApps - planning applications referred to the Mayor
sources.verified_claim: PlanApps supports application search, filters, comments and alerts; platform availability is not exact candidate application evidence.

sources.title: Borough webpages
sources.verified_claim: GLA directs users to borough planning registers for most applications, reinforcing that exact local application records are required.

sources.title: Planning application decisions
sources.verified_claim: The decisions archive records specific strategic cases and reports; unrelated historical decisions are context only and not candidate evidence.
